observation: V4 N64 fused-scratch routed-block medians improved 44.11-45.42 percent with exact tested intermediates/outputs on all four GPUs. Prior integrated TP4 pilot measured 75.59620179700826 C1 tokens/s; original EXL3 serving median was 91.2645.
hypothesis: N64 FC1 ownership plus a single scratch clear improves integrated C1 throughput without disabling FULL CUDA graphs or changing the full-model serving regime.
rivals: Device-block gain does not transfer to end-to-end serving.
Graph capture retains extra arena storage or dispatches a fallback.
Unchanged attention, dense paths, communication and scheduling dominate the remaining gap.
experimental_unit: One prepared server start. Requests and token timing samples are subsamples, not independent cold starts.
primary_estimand: 32K-context concurrency-1 aggregate decode tokens/s, same 20-second benchmark protocol as the authenticated prior integrated pilot.
secondary_estimand: Standalone 32K prefill client tokens/s using the same prior protocol.
benchmark_integrity_gate: Exact duration-mode metadata (20 seconds, 3-second warmup, C1, max_tokens 4096, standalone cold prefill), continuous OpenAI usage source, zero errors and no underfill/timeout/capacity limit. Positive integer client prefill samples. Token-target estimate permits actual decode and prefill prompt lengths within plus/minus 5 percent of 32768; measured duration must be 19-21 seconds. Four-GPU hardware receipts and temperatures below 90 C required. These limits are fixed before first launch.
decision_rule: Report measured throughput only after all 168 native forward and actual M1 dispatch pairs, completed FULL capture, correct model endpoint, successful benchmark, and cleanup/restoration receipts pass. Compare descriptively with prior P8 and EXL3 measurements. A pilot exceeding EXL3 authorizes proposing a separate five-cold-run comparison, not restarting allocation. A pilot below EXL3 leaves allocation stopped.
control: Authenticated prior TP4/noEP/DCP1 P8 small-M serving pilot; no concurrent control or new EXL3 measurement. EXL3 historical system reference is TP4/EP4/DCP4, not an isolated codec comparison.
run_order: Authenticate all four V4 device prerequisites, acquire model-stack lock, preserve/stop prior services, one server start, graph/runtime audit, standalone prefill then warmed duration-based decode as ordered by the authenticated benchmark, stop owned container, restore prior service states.
failure_policy: Preserve every failure and incomplete attempt. No automatic rerun or silent replacement. A changed runner, candidate, protocol or failed attempt requires explicit amended plan and fresh output version.
authorization: User authorized autonomous local codec/serving optimization and parallel agents. GPU work remains serialized; private publication only.
codec_contract: All 42 routed layers, K4 procedural MCG to E4M3 with UE8M0/32 identity, 4.25 routed bpw, no LDLQ. P8 mxf8f6f4 has twice NVFP4 MMA issue count and is not native P4 speed class.
quality_boundary: No new KLD or full-model numerical-closure claim. M1 optimization was tested on the frozen device matrix; prompt-prefill KLD alone would not qualify this decode path.
